**About the Role**
==================

As a **Trader** at Thndr, you will play a critical role in supporting our Saudi brokerage dealing-desk capability and ensuring reliable day-to-day trading activity on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul).

You will monitor automated order flow and trading activity, oversee the performance of trading systems, identify unusual activity, spikes, exceptions, or potential issues, and take appropriate action or escalate when required. You will work closely with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure trading activity remains accurate, controlled, and compliant with applicable CMA requirements.

If you have hands-on trading experience in the Saudi market, strong knowledge of Tadawul and trading systems, and the ability to identify and respond to trading issues quickly and accurately, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Trading Monitoring & Oversight:**

* Monitor automated client order flow and trading activity throughout the trading session.
* Oversee trading-system performance and identify unusual activity, spikes, anomalies, or potential issues.
* Monitor order status and identify rejected, delayed, or irregular orders.
* Investigate trading exceptions and determine the appropriate action or escalation.
* Escalate trading issues promptly to the relevant teams when intervention is required.
* Monitor market conditions and assess their potential impact on trading activity.
* Maintain accurate and auditable records of trading activity, exceptions, and incidents.

**Regulatory & Risk Management:**

* Ensure trading activity is conducted in line with applicable CMA regulations, market rules, and internal controls.
* Apply pre-trade controls and trading limits and monitor adherence to established trading parameters.
* Work closely with Risk and Compliance on trade surveillance and the identification and escalation of suspicious or unusual trading activity.
* Support the investigation and documentation of trading incidents, errors, and potential market-abuse concerns.
* Exercise sound judgement and maintain a high level of integrity when monitoring trading activity.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS) Technical Engineer** to lead the architecture, deployment, customisation, and integration of IBM MAS across our enterprise clients. In this role, you will be responsible for setting up the MAS environment (OpenShift/hybrid cloud), tailoring business logic and UI to client specifications, and integrating existing legacy applications and ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, SCADA, GIS) into the Maximo ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architecture & Setup:**
* + Plan, configure, and maintain IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS 8/9+) core components, including **MAS Manage**, **MAS Monitor**, **MAS Health**, and **MAS Predict**.
  + Collaborate with cloud and infrastructure teams to support deployment on **Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (ROCP)** (on-premises or cloud-hosted).
  + Configure security, directory integration (LDAP/SAML/SSO), and role-based access controls.
* **Customisation & Configuration:**
* + Implement custom business logic using **Automation Scripts** (Jython/Python, JavaScript).
  + Customise applications using Maximo Application Designer, Database Configuration, Domains, and Workflow Designer.
  + Develop complex workflows matching standard operating and maintenance procedures.
* **Integration & Data Migration:**
* + Design and configure enterprise integrations using **Maximo Integration Framework (MIF)**, REST APIs, JSON, and Kafka/MQ queues.
  + Integrate MAS with external systems such as ERPs (SAP/Oracle), IoT/SCADA platforms, GIS (Esri), and document management repositories.
  + Plan and execute data migration and schema mapping from legacy Maximo (v7.6) or external systems to MAS.
* **Testing, Go-Live & Client Engagement:**
* + Conduct unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  + Provide technical documentation including technical architecture designs, interface control documents (ICDs), and operational runbooks.
  + Deliver client handover sessions and tier-3 technical troubleshooting during stabilization.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

The Team:

We are an award winning global consultancy and have been named Building’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022 and 2021. We are at the forefront of the industry, priding ourselves on our exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable projects.

Cundall’s Structural Engineering team prides itself in their exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable structural solutions, that minimise the use of natural resources. As one of the longest established of Cundall’s many disciplines, the Structural team are a source of world leading expertise – and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with an experienced background in structural engineering to join our team at our office in Riyadh to work on the design of some of the most exciting structural design projects in KSA and regionally.

As part of our established team of expert engineers and CAD technicians, and working closely with colleagues of various disciplines, you will prepare detailed structural calculations for multiple materials and using appropriate software. You will work across a variety of sectors such as Education, Commercial, Healthcare, Retail and Critical Systems, and will have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and as you work and are supported towards Chartership.

The Skills:

Having already been accredited with a BEng degree level (or equivalent), you will have gained strong practical experience of structural engineering within a consultancy environment, and be proficient in the use of design and modelling software such as Etabs, Safe, SAP, Robot, Prokon, and IDEA StatiCa. You will be familiar with producing creative design solutions in multiple materials, including steel, reinforced concrete and masonry, and crucially - have a passion for creative and intuitive design.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

  
  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Project Controls & Change Management Manager** to join our team! In this role, you will work closely with the Project Controls Director and management, engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, contracts, finance, and client representatives to assess the impact of changes and support informed project decision-making.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

### **Project Controls Management**

* Establish and implement project controls procedures, systems, tools, and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain the project control baseline, including scope, schedule, cost, resources, and key performance indicators.
* Oversee the preparation and maintenance of the integrated master schedule.
* Ensure that project budgets, commitments, actual costs, forecasts, and cash flows are accurately maintained.
* Monitor project performance against approved cost and schedule baselines.
* Review schedule updates, progress reports, cost reports, forecasts, and variance analyses.
* Ensure timely identification of trends, deviations, risks, and opportunities.
* Coordinate the preparation of monthly project performance reports and executive dashboards.
* Ensure consistent reporting across project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
* Lead the development of recovery plans for projects experiencing cost, schedule, or performance issues.
* Support earned value management, productivity analysis, resource planning, and performance measurement activities.
* Ensure project control data is accurate, complete, traceable, and suitable for management decision-making.

### **Change Management**

* Establish and administer the project change management and change control process.
* Manage the identification, registration, assessment, approval, implementation, and closeout of project changes.
* Maintain the project change register, trend register, potential change log, and associated records.
* Review change requests, change notices, variation orders, field instructions, design

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled **Sales Engineer – MEP** to join our trading division in **Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for promoting a diverse portfolio of mechanical products such as pipes, valves, fittings, flanges, and other MEP items, targeting industrial, infrastructure, and building projects across the Kingdom.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Promote and sell mechanical product ranges including piping systems, valves, flanges, and fittings.
* Identify new clients and develop strong relationships with consultants, contractors, EPC companies, and project owners.
* Handle project sales, BOQ take-offs, quotation preparation, and technical submittals.
* Track ongoing tenders, construction projects, and key procurement opportunities in the Riyadh market.
* Coordinate with internal departments for inventory, pricing, order processing, and logistics.
* Conduct product presentations and provide technical clarification and support to clients.
* Monitor competitor activity and market trends to support sales strategy.
* Ensure timely follow-up on quotations, project approvals, deliveries, and payment collections.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* **4–5 years of experience in MEP/trading sales**, preferably handling pipes, valves, fittings, and related mechanical products.
* Strong understanding of piping systems and specifications related to HVAC, firefighting, and plumbing.
* Experience or knowledge of the **Saudi construction, MEP, or oil & gas market** is preferred.
* **Valid Saudi Driving License is mandatory.**
* Familiarity with SAP/ERP systems and project tracking tools is an advantage.

**Key Skills Required**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong negotiation, client relationship, and sales closing skills.
* Ability to read and understand project drawings and specifications.
* Goal-oriented with the ability to meet targets independently.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.
* Strong interpersonal and networking skills.

Work Location: In person

We are looking for an **Integration & Architecture Consultant** with strong hands-on experience in **SAP Integration Suite (SAP CPI)**, integration architecture, iFlow development, SAP and non-SAP integrations, data transformation, security, monitoring, and performance optimization.

The consultant should have strong end-to-end understanding of integration architecture across **SAP BTP, CPI, SAP R/3, and external systems**.

1. Core Integration Skills

* Extensive knowledge of **SAP Integration Suite (SAP CPI)**.
* Strong understanding of **end-to-end integration architecture**, including:
  + SAP BTP
  + SAP CPI
  + SAP R/3
  + External systems
* Strong experience designing and developing **iFlows (integration flows)**.
* Extensive knowledge of integration patterns, including:
  + Content-based routing
  + Message transformation

  + XML
  + JSON
  + XSLT
* Extensive knowledge of **APIs and web services**, including:
  + REST
  + SOAP
  + OData
* Strong experience with **error handling and exception subprocesses**.
* Extensive knowledge of **synchronous and asynchronous integration scenarios**.

  + SFTP
  + IDoc
  + SOAP
  + REST
  + OData
  + Ariba
  + Other relevant CPI adapters

* Strong experience handling:
  + IDocs
  + RFC integrations

3. Data Transformation & Processing

  + XML
  + JSON
  + CSV
  + EDI
* Strong experience with:
  + Value mapping
  + Parameterization
  + Data transformation

4. Security & Compliance

* Extensive knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms, including:
  + OAuth
  + Basic Authentication
  + Client Certificates
* Strong experience with:
  + Encryption
  + Decryption
  + Message security

job_description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, review and maintain integrated master schedules for dam O&M projects and related program activities.
* Review contractors’ baseline schedules, detailed work programs, maintenance schedules and schedule updates.
* Confirm that submitted schedules reflect contractual requirements, approved scope, key milestones and delivery priorities.
* Establish work breakdown structures, activity coding, calendars, logical relationships, milestones and schedule-control procedures.
* Integrate civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, instrumentation, inspection and maintenance activities into coordinated schedules.
* Monitor progress against approved baseline and current schedules.
* Measure actual progress using approved progress-measurement methods and supporting records.
* Analyze planned-versus-actual performance, critical paths, float consumption and schedule trends.
* Identify variances, emerging delays, sequencing conflicts, resource constraints and potential milestone impacts.
* Prepare schedule forecasts and estimate future resource, equipment, material and delivery requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance work schedules with operations teams, contractors, consultants and relevant stakeholders.
* Support the scheduling of preventive, predictive, corrective and emergency maintenance activities.
* Coordinate work windows, shutdowns, equipment isolation and return-to-service requirements with operational teams.
* Maintain short-term, medium-term and long-term schedules, including weekly and monthly look-ahead plans.
* Review contractors’ manpower and equipment deployment against planned requirements.
* Assess the time impact of scope changes, variations, claims, delayed approvals and other project events.
* Support delay analysis and provide factual schedule information for contractual and management reviews.
* Recommend corrective actions, schedule-recovery measures and revised sequencing where required.
* Review recovery schedules and monitor the implementation and effectiveness of approved recovery plans.
* Maintain schedule assumptions, constraints, progress records, productivity data and supporting documentation.
* Develop schedule dashboards, progress curves, milestone trackers and management-reporting tools.
* Calculate and report planning and scheduling KPIs, including progress variance, milestone performance, schedule adherence and forecast completion.
* Reconcile schedule information with SAP maintenance plan

job_description:
Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier, better life for all.
  
  
With a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence of more than 100 subsidiaries, we operate on a truly global scale. Since our establishment in 1958, our dedication to enhancing lives worldwide through innovative products has remained unwavering. Our business domains include Home Appliance & Air Solution, Home Entertainment, Vehicle Components Solutions, and Business Solutions.
  
Our management philosophy, ""Jeong-do Management,"" embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer-Value Creation' and 'People-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom, fostering a collaborative work environment.
  
  
Join us and become a part of a company that is not just about creating solutions for a better life, because at LG, Life's Good.

### **What you'll do**

  

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share targets for the Built-in Appliance business.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, including developers, contractors, kitchen companies, consultants, distributors, and retailers.
* Identify and secure new business opportunities, projects, and strategic partnerships.
* Manage the sales cycle from lead generation and product specification to negotiation, order placement, and project completion.
* Conduct regular business reviews with customers and develop account growth plans.
* Monitor project pipelines and provide accurate sales forecasts and market insights.
* Negotiate pricing, contracts, and commercial agreements to maximize business performance.
* Collaborate with marketing, logistics, finance, and service teams to ensure seamless customer support and project execution.
* Track market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities.
* Ensure achievement of sales targets, collection objectives, and customer satisfaction goals.
Prepare periodic sales reports, account performance analyses, and management presentations.  

### **What you must have**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administ

The Project Controls Engineer is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely reporting of project data. This role plays a crucial part in maintaining the integrity of cost, schedule, and progress information, and supports various project functions with data analysis and reporting.

Assignment duration: Until the end of 2026, with the possibility of extension.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to report to executives.

Job Purpose

To support SAP MM/WM/LE implementation and configuration by aligning business processes with SAP solutions, assisting in procurement and inventory functions, and providing ongoing system support and documentation in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Key Accountability Areas

SAP Configuration & Implementation:

* Independently configure enterprise structure, purchasing processes, and plant parameters in SAP.
* Map and analyze business processes, translating them into SAP To-Be solutions aligned with legacy system integrations.
* Lead configuration efforts during SAP Greenfield and brownfield implementation projects, particularly in sourcing and procurement.

Functional Expertise in MM/WM/IM/LE:

* Design and configure procurement operations including Purchase Orders, Subcontracting, Pricing Procedures, Automatic Account Determination, and MRP.
* Manage inventory processes such as Goods Receipts, Goods Issues, Transfer Postings, Stock Transfers, and Physical Inventory.
* Customize release strategies for PRs, POs, Contracts, and Service Orders in manufacturing environments.

Integration & SAP Tools:

* Utilize SAP tools like IDoc, BAPI, BDC, LSMW, and FIORI apps for integration, data migration, and process automation.
* Collaborate with technical teams to develop and test interfaces and integration points.

Project Management & Collaboration:

* Participate actively in requirement gathering, blueprinting, solution design, testing, training, and go-live support.
* Liaise with business analysts, developers, and other SAP consultants to ensure end-to-end process alignment and project success.
* Mentor junior consultants and support team members.

Training & Documentation:

* Develop and deliver training materials and sessions to end users.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of configurations, business processes, and support procedures.

* Gather detailed business requirements and develop Functional Specifications for RICEF objects.
* Drive collaboration across cross-functional teams during design workshops and testing cycles.

Job description:
  
  
Job Purpose

Focuses on day-to-day support of system issues, configuration updates, and enhancements, while working with stakeholders to translate requirements into effective solutions. Providing user training, ensuring alignment with SuccessFactors best practices, and supporting complete and accurate business processes. Expertise in SuccessFactors Recruiting and Onboarding is essential, with additional knowledge of SAP HCM Payroll, Time Management, and integration points considered beneficial.

Key Accountability Areas

Incident Management:

* Hold primary responsibility for managing and resolving incidents related to SuccessFactors modules, ensuring minimal disruption to HR operations.
* Receive, assess, and prioritize incident tickets across all SuccessFactors modules.
* Provide functional support for SAP Payroll and Time Management–related incidents.
* Investigate and diagnose technical issues, functional discrepancies, and data-related problems reported by end-users.
* Develop and implement effective solutions to resolve incidents efficiently, ensuring minimal system downtime.
* Ensure adherence to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for timely incident resolution.

Business Process Enhancement:

* Support and optimize SuccessFactors modules to enhance business functionality and overall system performance, while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Configure and customize relevant business areas to ensure system behavior aligns with defined business requirements and constraints.
* Prepare comprehensive test scripts and perform testing activities, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing, Performance Testing, User Acceptance Testing, Regression Testing, and any client-specific testing procedures.
* Provide detailed Functional Specifications to the Technical Team for custom development requirements.

Documentation:

* Document configuration settings and prepare clear, detailed guidelines to enable other consultants to perform future modifications or repairs with accuracy and efficiency.

HR Proficiency:

* Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job.

* Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules.
* Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time.
* Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks.

job_description:
**Job Purpose**

This role will be responsible for transforming digital, customer, marketing and commercial data into actionable insights that drive growth, improve customer experience and optimize business performance.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Tableau and Looker Studio, with the ability to connect customer behavior with commercial performance and translate complex data into clear business actions.

**Location: Open to remote candidates based in the GCC**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital & E-commerce Analytics:**

* Own analysis of e-commerce and digital performance across the complete customer journey.
* Use GA4, Tableau and Looker Studio to analyze customer behavior, commercial performance and marketing effectiveness.
* Analyze key KPIs including traffic, CVR, AOV, UPT, revenue per user, cart abandonment, checkout abandonment, ROAS and CAC.
* Build and analyze customer funnels across landing pages, PLP, PDP, cart, checkout and purchase.
* Identify funnel leakage, customer friction and commercial opportunities and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Analyze performance by market, device, channel, category, product, campaign and customer segment.
* Move beyond reporting what happened to explain why it happened and what actions should be taken.

**GA4 & Digital Measurement**

* Act as the team's GA4 subject-matter expert, owning the digital measurement and analytics framework.
* Use GA4 for customer journey, acquisition, engagement, conversion and e-commerce analysis.
* Demonstrate advanced knowledge of GA4 events, parameters, key events, audiences, explorations, funnels and e-commerce reporting.
* Understand and validate e-commerce tracking including view\_item, add\_to\_cart, begin\_checkout and purchase.
* Build custom explorations and funnel analyses to identify opportunities across the customer journey.
* Work closely with Product and Technology teams to define event tracking, data layers and measurement requirements for new features and customer journeys.
* Regularly audit GA4 implementation and investigate discrepancies between GA4 and transactional/business data.
* Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM) and GA4 debugging/validation is highly desirable.

**Tableau & Looker Studio**

* Own the development and evolution of Tableau and Looker Studio dashboards across Omni-Commerce.
* Build scalable, intuitive and executive-ready dashboards covering e-commerce, marketing

job_description:
We are looking for a commercially minded and analytical Social Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Social & Digital team. The role will focus on analysing social media performance, identifying audience and content trends, and translating data into actionable insights that improve our clients' social media strategies, engagement and overall campaign effectiveness.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with a solid understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing and audience behaviour.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor, analyse and report on social media performance across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat and other relevant platforms
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards, reports and KPI tracking frameworks for clients and internal teams
* Analyse audience behaviour, engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, content performance and conversion metrics
* Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations to improve content strategy and campaign performance
* Conduct competitor benchmarking, social listening and industry trend analysis
* Work closely with Social Media, Creative, Strategy and Account Management teams to support data-driven decision-making
* Measure the effectiveness of organic and paid social campaigns, identifying opportunities for optimisation
* Support campaign planning, client pitches and strategic recommendations with relevant research and data
* Present performance findings and insights to internal stakeholders and clients
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and reporting best practices across accounts

**Requirements**
**What We're Looking For**
Someone who goes beyond producing reports and can explain what the data means, why performance is changing and what we should do next.
  
  
You should be curious, proactive and commercially aware, with the ability to turn social media data into insights that influence creative decisions, strengthen client relationships and deliver measurable results.
  
  

* Minimum 3 years' experience in social media analytics, digital marketing analytics or a similar role, ideally within an agency environment
* Strong knowledge of social media analytics tools such as Sprout Social, Emplifi
* Strong understanding of social media KPIs, audience insights, campaign measurement and performance optimisation
* Ability to interpret large datasets and communicate meaningful insights to non-technical stake

**Why qlub**
The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.
  
  
From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

You'll lead product analytics at qlub and build the experimentation engine behind our growth, scaling to 50+ A/B tests a month. * Define the analytical data model: entity and event design that joins consistently across product flows, slowly changing dimensions, a semantic layer, and metric definitions.

James L Williams Middle East is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Senior Quantity Surveyor to join our Commercial team and support the successful delivery of major Data Centre projects.
  
  
This role is responsible for managing the commercial and contractual aspects of projects from tender stage through to final account, ensuring effective cost control, contract administration, financial reporting, and commercial risk management while maximising project profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the day-to-day commercial and contractual activities of assigned projects from tender stage through to final completion.
* Prepare and evaluate interim valuations, payment applications, payment certificates, and final accounts.
* Measure and value variations, prepare variation claims, and negotiate commercial settlements.

job_description:
Job Purpose / Role :

Design, develop, configure, integrate, and maintain Oracle BSS platforms and solutions across CRM, Product Catalog, Order Management, Billing, Charging, Revenue Management, and Subscription Management, ensuring scalability, performance, security, reliability, and alignment with business and technical requirements.

Duties & Responsibilities:

• Design and implement Oracle BSS solutions across CRM, Product Catalog, Order Management, Billing, Charging, Revenue Management, and Subscription Management.

• Demonstrate and maintain BSS functionalities, workflows, APIs, custom components, and integrations to meet business and operational requirements.

• Classify and integrate BSS platforms with OSS, Digital Channels, ERP, payment gateways, data platforms, middleware, API gateways, and external systems.

• Lead the configuration and optimization of BSS products, business rules, pricing models, product offerings, charging rules, billing cycles, discounts, and customer lifecycle processes.

• Perform software development activities, including coding, database development, unit testing, debugging, code reviews, performance tuning, and defect resolution.

• Conduct impact analysis, technical design, solution implementation, system testing, and production validation for projects, change requests, and enhancements.

• Analyze and solve application, integration, database, and production issues through root cause analysis and corrective actions.

• Manage BSS upgrades, patches, releases, data migration, and post-production support to maintain platform performance, scalability, security, and reliability.

• Develop and maintain APIs, microservices, automation solutions, and DevOps pipelines to improve system integration, deployment, and operational efficiency.

• Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with business users, architects, QA, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to deliver and continuously improve BSS solutions.

Job Specifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

• Relevant certifications in BSS, Telecom, IT, Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, or related technologies are preferred.

• 4-7 years of experience in a related field.

**ERP System**

, a multi-tenant ERP platform encompassing
**Procurement, Accounting, Human Resources (HRM), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Service Operations**

,

and

. • Write and optimise SQL, including database views, and diagnose slow queries.

• Prepare release candidates: build, test, document the change and any required database steps, then hand over to the Managing Director for deployment.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, including setup steps, migration notes and known issues.

• Replace remaining third-party service dependencies (email, SMS, queuing, document storage) following the migration from cloud hosting to on-premise infrastructure.

• Review the Junior Developer's work, explain the reasoning behind corrections, and progressively transfer ownership of modules.

* Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments and identify system vulnerabilities and potential threats.

* Monitor cybersecurity risks, compliance, and risk exposure.
* Assess risks associated with major system changes and critical third-party suppliers.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of cybersecurity risk management frameworks.
* Communicate cybersecurity risks and recommendations to relevant stakeholders and senior management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of relevant cybersecurity risk management experience.
* Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Intermediate English proficiency.

job_description:
**About Deloitte**
: When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
  
  
**Our Purpose**

* Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
* Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:

During your tenure as a Consultant - Manager, you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas.
  
  
Conduct vulnerability assessments
  
  

* Networks: plan and run authenticated and unauthenticated assessments across corporate, data-Center, DMZ, wireless, guest-facing and partner-connected networks, including internal and internet-facing perimeter assessments
* Cloud platforms: assess Azure, AWS and GCP environments, covering workloads, configuration and identity settings against CIS benchmarks and NCA CCC, and scan container images and Kubernetes clusters
* Systems: assess Windows and Linux servers, endpoints, databases, virtualisation platforms, and network and security devices, including configuration and hardening checks against approved baselines
* Applications: assess web applications, APIs and mobile app back-ends with authenticated DAST scanning, working with the Application Security team on in-depth testing
* Assess new systems before go-live and after major changes, and run targeted assessments on request
* Produce clear assessment reports with risk-rated findings, evidence and practical remediation steps for each asset owner

Run tooling and coverage
  
  

* Operate and tune scanning platforms (e.g. Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7), including scan policies, credentials, schedules and agents
* Keep scan coverage aligned with the asset inventory and CMDB, and find and close blind spots, including new and unmanaged assets
*

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Cyber Security Project Manager to lead strategic cybersecurity initiatives across Trading, Forex, Brokerage, and Financial Services platforms. In this role, you will manage the end-to-end delivery of cybersecurity projects, ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of mission-critical systems while maintain compliance with financial regulations and industry security standards. The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with hands-on knowledge of cybersecurity technologies and experience working in highly regulated financial environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of cybersecurity projects across Trading, Forex, Brokerage, and Financial Services platforms.
* Manage security initiatives involving IAM, PAM, SIEM, SOC, Endpoint Security, DLP, Cloud Security, Network Security, Zero Trust, and Vulnerability Management.
* Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure, Trading Technology, DevOps, Application Development, Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit, and business teams.
* Ensure security controls are integrated into trading platforms, payment gateways, client portals, APIs, mobile applications, and cloud environments.
* Drive security initiatives supporting electronic trading platforms, FIX connectivity, market data services, payment processing, and digital customer channels.
* Develop project plans, budgets, RAID logs, governance reports, executive dashboards, and project documentation.
* Manage third-party cybersecurity vendors, implementation partners, penetration testing providers, and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs).
* Coordinate vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, security audits, remediation activities, and regulatory compliance initiatives.
* Lead cyber resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, and incident response readiness projects.
* Ensure timely delivery of remediation projects resulting from audits, regulatory inspections, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing.
* Provide regular project updates and executive reporting to senior leadership and governance committees.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 8+ years of project management experience, including delivery of cybersecurity projects.
* Experience within Trading, Forex, Brokerage, Capital Marke

**Company Description**
BITECH Middle East, established in 1998, is an Information Technology Resource Management company focused on delivering high-quality technical services and solutions at reasonable rates. Backed by 3,000 person-years of experience, BITECH supports information‑intense sectors such as Banking and Finance, Insurance, Retail and Distribution, Healthcare, Government and Utilities, Telecom, and Networking. The company offers application and product development, re-engineering, migration and legacy maintenance, strategic consulting, package implementation, education and training, and value-added professional services. BITECH’s delivery model leverages a strong knowledge base and Centers of Excellence to create industry-specific products, enabling clients to achieve fast, high-quality solutions. The organization is committed to providing a supportive work environment for consultants and staff.
  
**Role Description**
The Cyber Security Consultant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh. The consultant is responsible for assessing and improving the security posture of client environments, including applications, networks, and information systems. Day-to-day tasks include performing vulnerability assessments, analyzing security risks, recommending remediation measures, and supporting the implementation of security controls and best practices. The role involves collaborating with technical and business stakeholders, preparing clear security documentation and reports, and contributing to security policies, standards, and procedures. The consultant also helps educate teams on security awareness and supports ongoing monitoring and incident response activities.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Cybersecurity and Information Security principles, frameworks, and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with Network Security, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and secure network design.
* Proficiency in Application Security, including secure coding concepts, code review, and application penetration testing.
* Practical experience in Vulnerability Assessment, risk analysis, and prioritizing remediation activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or equivalent are desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to technical and non-technical stake

**Lead Consultant – FortiGuard Incident Response**

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. * Must be able to effectively communicate at all levels (executive leadership and technical support teams) within CrowdStrike.

The Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst (TIA) is a part of the Cyber Defense team, responsible to help collect, analyze, and disseminate cyber intelligence impacting the company or its customers. The ideal candidate will be a professional with experience in cyber intelligence/cyber risk, delivering equivalent services to organizations, with drive and creativity. This is a fantastic opportunity for a passionate professional that wants to evolve in the Cyber Intelligence world. The position will involve essential duties and responsibilities that must continue to be performed during crisis situations and contingency operations, which may necessitate extended hours of work.

* Identify, collect, and perform analysis of raw, primary, and secondary data derived from various sources.
* Create and update General Intelligence Requirements (GIR)s, Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIR)s, and Organization Specific Intelligence Requirements (OSIR)s for customers.
* Create threat profiles and threat landscapes for companies and or customers.
* Create diamond models around customers and threat adversaries.
* Improve the creation and delivery of intelligence information to customers and partners, via different reports and tools, linking the dots and adding value to the service delivered.
* Perform investigations on the internet and dark web on different topics, from broad investigations to specific searches.
* Identify, assess, and track tactics, techniques, and procedures of cyber threat actors.
* Provide threat review and validation to customers on their exposure to cyber security risks, threats, and potential impact.
* Provide actionable strategic, technical, and tactical cyber intelligence to company & its subsidiaries through weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports, briefings, and presentations.

**About Gramian**
Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**OT Cybersecurity Specialist**
to support and deliver cybersecurity assessments across
**industrial and operational technology environments**
. You will evaluate OT security maturity, controls, risks, and compliance against established industry frameworks while working closely with plant operations, engineering, and cybersecurity teams.
  
  
The role involves significant
**onsite work at operational facilities**
, including interviews, workshops, site inspections, and technical assessments. Candidates should be comfortable spending extended periods onsite in Riyadh.
  
  

* CAPACITY: 1× FTE — 40 hours per week
* SENIORITY: 5+ years — Consultant / Manager level
* LANGUAGE: Fluent English
* LOCATION: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — onsite at client site
* DURATION: Ongoing — no specified end date

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct OT cybersecurity assessments across industrial and operational environments.

**Job Purpose:**

The role supports the organization's cybersecurity and business continuity objectives by maintaining robust network security controls, managing network-related security incidents, and ensuring the resilience and availability of critical network services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Implement, administer, and monitor network security controls in compliance with ISO 27001 standards.
* Manage firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, 27001, NCA, wireless security, DNS, DHCP, and remote access solutions.
* Maintain secure network segmentation, access controls, routing policies, and traffic filtering.
* Monitor and respond to network security incidents, perform investigations, and coordinate remediation activities with relevant IT teams.
* Ensure continuous network visibility through log management, SIEM integration, and security monitoring.
* Conduct security reviews, configuration audits, firewall rule assessments, and vulnerability remediation.
* Support secure connectivity for third parties, cloud environments, VPNs, and disaster recovery infrastructure.

1. التصميم والتخطيط الهندسي

\* إعداد المخططات والرسومات الكهربائية (الكابلات، الإضاءة، القوى، والمآخذ) باستخدام برامج مثل AutoCAD وRevit.

\* تصميم شبكات التوزيع والتغدية الكهربائية، ولوحات التحكم (MDB, SDB).

\* إجراء حسابات الأحمال الكهربائية (Load Calculations)، وحجم القواطع، وهبوط الجهد (Voltage Drop)، وحسابات الشورت سيركت.

\* تحديد مواصفات وأنظمة الحماية والأرضي (Earthing System) ومانعات الصواعق.

2. الإشراف والتنفيذ الميداني

\* الإشراف على أعمال التركيبات الكهربائية في الموقع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات المعتمدة والأكواد الهندسية.

\* مطابقة المواد والتوريدات للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة في المشروع.

\* التنسيق مع التخصصات الأخرى (مدني، ميكانيك، معماري) لمنع التعارضات في الموقع.

3. التشغيل واختبار الأنظمة (Commissioning & Testing)

\* فحص واختبار المعدات واللوحات قبل التشغيل الفعلي (مثل اختبارات العزل وتحمل الجهد).

\* معايرة الأجهزة وأنظمة التحكم والتأكد من سلامة عمل نظام الحماية والإنذار.

4. الصيانة والدعم الفني

\* وضع خطط الصيانة الوقائية (Preventive Maintenance) والصيانة الدورية للمعدات والمولدات والمحولات.

\* تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية (Troubleshooting) وإصلاحها بشكل سريع لضمان استمرارية العمل.

5. السلامة وإدارة المشاريع

\* تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية (OSHA / معايير الكود المحلي) للحد من مخاطر الصعق والحرائق.

\* إعداد جداول الكميات (BOQ) والتكلفة التقديرية للأعمال الكهربائية.

\* متابعة الجدول الزمني لإنجاز الأعمال وتوثيق التقارير الفنية.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Shall Include but not limited to:

* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise network systems including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless infrastructure.
* Support and optimize satellite communication (LEO/GEO) connectivity for remote and offshore sites.
* Administer and configure network access control systems (e.g., Aruba ClearPass).
* Utilize network monitoring tools such as SolarWinds for proactive issue detection and performance optimization.
* Implement and maintain DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, and firewall rules.
* Support and configure WAN optimization appliances and technologies to enhance remote connectivity.
* Perform advanced network configurations including VPN, BGP, OSPF, ACLs, QoS, and NAT.
* Manage and respond to security threats using IDS/IPS and assist in network hardening activities.
* Assist in capacity planning, documentation, and upgrades of network infrastructure.
* Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement projects.
* Provide on-call and after-hours support as needed and support remote site connectivity issues.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Industry certifications such as CCIE, CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or Aruba Certified are preferred.
* Experience with enterprise wireless (e.g., Aruba, Cisco), ClearPass, and SD-WAN are highly desirable.
* Knowledge and hands-on experience with WAN optimizers, firewalls, VPNs, and IP networking protocols
* Familiarity with satellite communication technologies (LEO/GEO) is an advantage.

**SKILLS**

* Strong understanding of IP networking, routing, switching, and subnetting.
* Experience with enterprise wireless design, deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to monitor, interpret, and act on network alerts and trends (e.g., via SolarWinds).
* Ability to configure and troubleshoot complex network topologies and protocols.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a dedicated and versatile
**Application Support Specialist**
to be the primary point of contact for all software-related needs across the company. In this role, you will play a vital part in empowering our workforce by providing comprehensive user support, troubleshooting complex application issues, and ensuring seamless day-to-day operations across our entire application landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Comprehensive User Support:**
  Act as the go-to resource for employees across all departments, offering prompt, effective assistance for any issues or questions related to company-wide applications.
* **Incident Troubleshooting & Resolution:**
  Diagnose, analyze, and resolve technical problems reported by users—ranging from login and permission errors to application bugs, workflow disruptions, and data discrepancies.
* **Ticket Management & Tracking:**
  Manage support requests efficiently through our IT service management ticketing system, ensuring issues are prioritized, investigated, and resolved within established service-level agreements (SLAs).
* **User Training & Enablement:**
  Guide users on best practices, software functionalities, and proper data entry to minimize recurring errors and maximize application adoption.
* **Vendor & IT Escalation:**
  Coordinate with internal IT teams and external software vendors when issues require deep-code fixes, system patches, or specialized technical intervention.
* **Access & Configuration Management:**
  Handle user onboarding/offboarding tasks, configure role-based access permissions, and maintain user profiles across various platforms.
* **Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:**
  Create and update clear troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the internal knowledge base.

**Location: Riyadh, Saudi**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an Operations Support Engineer to ensure the smooth, secure, and continuous operation of IT systems in a business-critical live operational environment.The role will provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support across Windows servers, workstations, hardware, applications, and basic network infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting system issues, monitoring logs, performing preventive maintenance, supporting deployments and patching, and coordinating with vendors and internal teams to maintain system availability and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Biometric scanners

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Electronics
* or a related technical discipline.

* IT Operations

* Infrastructure Support
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure in a live, business-critical operational environment.
* Willingness to work in shifts and provide on-call support.
* Required Technical Skills
* Windows & System Administration

The Service Desk Senior Officer is the primary point of contact for technical issues within a company.

The objective is to maintain employee and system productivity through timely diagnosis and resolution of hardware, software, networking, and related technical concerns.

To work on day-to-day activities to provide technical support for company users within policies and procedures.

* To support business user’s PC’s, Laptops, Hardware and software.

* Participate in incident and accident investigations as required in line with agreed safety, health and environment policies, procedures and controls
